propositions: A non-existent or unmapped Jira project key configured in the bridge causes the inbound fetcher to fail the entire pass rather than returning empty, because real Jira parse-errors on unknown project keys and acli exits non-zero with no per-project exception handling.

Live Cloud-only testing against two shared production projects cannot faithfully model all required repo configurations (one/two/zero repos), empty projects, and unknown-project fail-closed paths without risking test data or production impact.
The rehearsal must verify that outbound mutations target only their intended project, with no cross-project contamination, before any bridge sync runs.
A bridge pass against a project key that was never created in the DC instance must fail closed and write no changes, as verified by post-run state inspection.

The existing ephemeral Jira DC test harness (tests/external/live_jira_dc/) provides admin rights and scratch project lifecycle, enabling reproducible CI-verified green runs in place of manual operator-attested Cloud validation.
